about: 품질검사요청현황 [비교기간](E040630) — 2026-10-13 원본 실측: 10/01~10/31 vs 전월(9/01~9/30) → 표가 옆으로 두 벌, 머리 첫 줄에 두 구간. 9월 줄은 오른쪽에만(왼쪽 빈칸, 검사방법 빈칸), 9월 묶음 계는 '[] 계' 와 오른쪽 수량, 10월 줄은 왼쪽에만, '2026/10 계'. 집계(품목별)도 두 벌: 이름 · 수량 | 이름 · 수량, 계 줄 오른쪽 이름 칸은 빈칸. QA재고2 요청을 이달 1일 · 지난달 1일에 하나씩(같은 품목) 넣고 본 다음 지운다.

shots.name: 이달 요청 3 · 지난달 요청 5 → 전월동일기간 → 현황 두 벌 · [] 계 → 집계 품목별 두 벌 → 지움
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const it = (await (await fetch('/api/items', { headers: H })).json()).filter((x) => x.active !== false); const d = new Date(); const p2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const cur = d.getFullYear() + '-' + p2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-01'; const pd = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() - 1, 1); const prev = pd.getFullYear() + '-' + p2(pd.getMonth() + 1) + '-01'; const mk = async (date, q) => (await (await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ requestDate: date, requester: 'QA재고2', remark: 'QA재고2', lines: [{ itemId: it[0].id, method: 'FULL', quantity: q }] }) })).json()); const a = await mk(cur, 3); const b = await mk(prev, 5); sessionStorage.setItem('qrc', JSON.stringify({ a: a.id, b: b.id, aNo: a.requestNo, bNo: b.requestNo, item: it[0].id, code: it[0].code, name: it[0].name, prevM: prev.slice(0, 7).replace('-', '/') })); return a.requestNo + ' / ' + b.requestNo })()

js:(async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qrc')); const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const S = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; const rq = [...document.querySelectorAll('li')].find((li) => li.innerText.trim().startsWith('품질검사요청No.')).querySelector('input'); S(rq, 'QR-'); [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((l) => l.innerText.trim() === '전월동일기간').querySelector('input').click(); await W(1500); return 'ok' })()

expect:(() => { const t = document.querySelector('table'); const h = [...t.tHead.rows[0].cells]; return h.length === 2 && h[0].colSpan === 5 && h[1].colSpan === 5 && t.tHead.rows[1].cells.length === 10 })()

expect:(() => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qrc')); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')]; const b = rows.find((r) => r.cells[5]?.innerText.includes('-' + Number(x.bNo.split('-').pop())) && r.cells[0].innerText.trim() === '' && r.innerText.includes(x.name)); return !!b && b.cells[7].innerText.trim() === '' && rows.some((r) => r.cells[0].innerText.trim() === '[] 계' && getComputedStyle(r.cells[0]).fontWeight === '700' && getComputedStyle(r.cells[0]).backgroundColor === 'rgb(247, 247, 247)') })()

expect:(() => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qrc')); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')]; return rows.some((r) => r.cells[0].innerText.includes('-' + Number(x.aNo.split('-').pop())) && r.cells[3].innerText.includes(x.name) && r.cells[5].innerText.trim() === '') })()

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((l) => l.innerText.trim() === '집계').querySelector('input').click(); await W(400); const sel = [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].find((s) => [...s.options].some((o) => o.value === '품목별')); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(sel, '품목별'); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await W(600); return 'ok' })()
expect:(() => { const t = document.querySelector('table'); return [...t.tHead.rows[1].cells].map((c) => c.innerText.trim()).join('|') === '품목별|수량|품목별|수량' })()

expect:(() => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qrc')); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')]; const r = rows.find((r) => r.cells[0].innerText.trim().startsWith(x.name) || r.cells[2].innerText.trim().startsWith(x.name)); return !!r && rows.some((y) => y.innerText.includes(' 계')) })()

js:(async () => { if (!(await ((async () => { const x = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qrc')); const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const a = await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests/' + x.a, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); const b = await fetch('/api/quality-inspection-requests/' + x.b, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return a.status === 204 && b.status === 204 })()))) throw new Error("저장 · 지움 단계 실패"); return true })()
